chars.RACHID: RACHID: a slim 22-year-old Moroccan man with short curly black hair and a thin beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.YAHYA: YAHYA: his younger brother, a 19-year-old Moroccan young man with a short fade haircut, clean-shaven, wearing a teal bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, light blue jeans
chars.STRANGER: STRANGER: a middle-aged Moroccan man with a grey moustache wearing a brown leather jacket and a flat cap
chars.DOCTOR: DOCTOR: a Moroccan female doctor in her forties wearing green surgical scrubs, a white coat and a surgical cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modern e-commerce office in Casablanca full of cardboard parcels and laptops, RACHID and YAHYA celebrate together, RACHID proudly pointing at a laptop screen with a rising sales chart while YAHYA high-fives him, both laughing, warm daylight.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night in the same Casablanca office, dark and empty except for the cold glow of a laptop; RACHID sits alone at the desk, tired, staring at the screen, a dark storm with lightning visible through the window behind him, ominous mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the busy Casablanca e-commerce office, YAHYA stands next to his brother's EMPTY desk chair (nobody sitting in it) holding his phone to his ear, frowning and worried, other parcels around, sunny window light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of YAHYA in the office receiving an incoming phone call, eyes wide in shock, one hand frozen on his forehead, coworkers in the blurred background turning to look at him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A Casablanca street in the morning: a crashed silver car with a smashed front against a lamp post, smoke rising, people gathering; STRANGER stands in front of it holding a smartphone to his ear with a grave face; an ambulance with flashing lights in the background. No people injured visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YAHYA runs in panic out of the office building into a Casablanca street, terrified expression, jacket flying, hailing a red petit taxi.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the accident site on the Casablanca street, police officers with tape around the crashed silver car, YAHYA desperately grabbing STRANGER by the arm asking him questions, STRANGER pointing down the road toward a hospital.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan public hospital corridor with fluorescent lights, YAHYA running toward closed double doors of the intensive care unit, a nurse stopping him with her hand, tense atmosphere.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Hospital corridor: DOCTOR just came out of the intensive care doors, removing her mask with a serious face, YAHYA grabs her arm with both hands, pleading and desperate, face to face in tension.
